title: Actionbar Coordinates
description: This lightweight, all-vanilla data pack adds a display of your current coordinates (X, Y, Z) to the Action Bar, right above the hotbar. No more constantly opening the debug screen (F3) – now all the information you need is always right at your fingertips.
body:
This lightweight, all-vanilla data pack adds a display of your current coordinates (X, Y, Z) to the Action Bar, right above the hotbar. No more constantly opening the debug screen (F3) – now all the information you need is always right at your fingertips.
